check_events.statement: For a surjective group homomorphism q:G→Q and an action by automorphisms on G, the formula q(g)↦q(α(g)) defines a descended action exactly when ker(q) is invariant under the action.
check_events.place: First paragraph, second de sorte que, concerning Θ prime 2 passing to the quotient
check_events.outcome: Verified directly in this run: invariance makes the formula independent of the lift g, and a descended action sends q(n)=1 to 1 for every n in ker(q), giving necessity. Surjectivity alone is insufficient: projection (Z/2)^2→Z/2 onto the first coordinate and swapping the two coordinates gives equal projected inputs (0,0),(0,1) whose swapped images project to 0 and 1. This is a scope check; it does not refute unstated hypotheses on this page.
